public.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
public.description: Unit-width histogram bars have nonnegative integer heights. Return the largest rectangular area lying under consecutive bars. There are 0 to 1000 bars, each at most 10000.
hints: A monotone stack identifies the first smaller bar on each side.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Popping a taller bar fixes its maximum-width rectangle. A zero sentinel flushes remaining bars. O(n) time and space.
